'''BBE-Line Biped Locomotion Units''' were bipedal locomotion parts for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] built by [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]]. Made of [[Copper/Legends|copper]], [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]] and high-[[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] [[Steel/Legends|steel]], they were both magnetic and lightweight&mdash;weighining only 12 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]. They were equipped with the walking, jumping and running ability and, despite their low [[Battery/Legends|battery]] usage, they had a high material durability.
